Digital Marketing Assistant

Company: Rosewood Grocers
Location: Fredericton, NB
Work Arrangement: On-site
Work Term: Fall 2026
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $22.50 per hour

About the Role

Rosewood Grocers operates twelve independent grocery stores in New Brunswick. The Digital
Marketing Assistant will support our email and social media programs.

Responsibilities

- Build weekly email campaigns and monitor engagement
- Schedule social media content across channels
- Support digital marketing reporting for store managers

How to Apply

Apply by November 20. Late applications will not be considered.
